messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 — page fired for inference-api-prod (embeddings queue). Symptoms: 5xx spike, embeddings errors rising, region=us-west-2. Pager: @oncall-sre. Incident URL: https://pagerduty.example/PD-12345

alex: ack — I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking recent deploys.

samir: ack — I can jump in as mitigation owner if needed. @alex want me to lead?

alex: please take owner. I'll revert infra changes if it's autoscaler related.

samir: taking ownership. quick plan: pin routing to dedicated-pool-2, scale replicas, then rollback recent model if needed. ETA ~3m.

maria: support here — seeing ~12 customer error reports (embeddings failing). I'll open a ticket and prep a customer note.

oncall-sre: runbook link: https://confluence.example/runbooks/embeddings-5xx. Key checklist: 1) check pool utilization and KV-cache evictions 2) scale reserved replicas 3) pin routing/fallback to backup model 4) rollback autoscaler change if present.

samir: running scale command now: `kubectl -n inference scale statefulset embeddings-pool --replicas=6`

samir: quick log excerpt: "evicting kv cache: memory=91% threshold=85%" — looks like GPU memory pressure after the last model swap.

alex: I see an autoscaler policy change at 02:05 (burst mode enabled). Reverting to `steady-sla-v2` now. Might be underprovisioning steady-state.

incidentbot: update — samir claimed mitigation, alex working autoscaler revert. Assigned: samir, alex. Bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/abcd

support: maria opened SUP-6623 and started customer notifications. Draft message: "We're investigating increased embeddings errors; mitigation is underway and we expect reduced errors within 15-30 minutes. We'll update you shortly."

samir: scale completed, replicas=6. Routing pinned to dedicated-pool-2. Error rate dropped ~70% within 90s. Monitoring for regressions.

oncall-sre: good progress. Keep an eye on eviction logs and GPU mem. If evictions persist, we may need to rollback to model-backup-1.

alex: autoscaler policy revert deployed. watching autoscale events.

maria: customers notified, CSMs looped in. No new priority escalations so far.

samir: current status: mitigated (partial). Next steps: 1) monitor 15m 2) prepare rollback if evictions continue 3) follow-up postmortem and add autoscaler test coverage. ETA to full resolve ~25m.

incidentbot: incidentstatus -> mitigated (partial). last_update_ts=1767623850

support: thanks all — keep posting short pings. I'll update ticket with timeline and customer messages. :thumbsup:
